findings.title: A discount above 100% makes the price negative
findings.explanation: apply_discount accepts any percent, so apply_discount(100, 150) returns -50. A negative price could be charged or refunded by mistake.
findings.impact_reason: Wrong money amounts for any caller that passes a bad percent; the function is public.

findings.title: Admin password is written in the source code
findings.explanation: Anyone who can read the repository knows the admin password.

findings.title: Passwords are hashed with MD5
findings.explanation: MD5 is fast and broken for passwords; stolen hashes can be cracked quickly.

findings.title: bulk_price has no tests
findings.quote: return [apply_discount(p, percent) for p in prices]
findings.explanation: No test runs bulk_price, so a change to it or to apply_discount would go unnoticed.
findings.impact_reason: Public helper that builds on the discount logic.

findings.title: Unused import in pricing module
findings.explanation: os is imported but never used.

findings.title: find_duplicates compares every pair of items
findings.explanation: The nested loop grows with the square of the list size; a set would do it in one pass.
findings.impact_reason: Slows down on large order lists.

findings.title: SQL injection in the user lookup
findings.quote: cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" + name + "'")
findings.explanation: User input is pasted into SQL.

findings.title: apply_discount is not thread-safe
findings.explanation: Concurrent callers could corrupt each other's results (thread-safe).

thread-safe.reason: the function only does arithmetic on its arguments and shares no state

elephant.title: Reject discounts outside 0-100%
elephant.intent: apply_discount must never return a negative price: percentages outside 0-100 are rejected.
constraints: Do not change public function names
A bug fix must come with a test that fails before the fix
success_criteria: apply_discount raises ValueError for a percent below 0 or above 100
Valid discounts return the same values as before

verification.description: New tests for invalid percents pass and the old tests still pass

abort_conditions: A file outside the allowed paths needs to change
elephant.rollback: Discard branch evolve/<id>; no data migration is involved.
elephant.body:
## Root cause
`apply_discount` does arithmetic on any percent, so values above 100 give negative prices.

## Approach
1. Raise `ValueError` when percent is outside 0-100.
2. Add tests for 150%, -5% and the boundaries 0 and 100.
